entries.title: Sources detail how the Microsoft 365 outage began in Switzerland and spread as failover systems shifted traffic, leaving 80%+ of Exchange servers unresponsive (Tom Warren/The Verge)
On Q3 earnings call, Nvidia Chair Harvey Jones says the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO (Hayden Field/The Verge)
Suno launches Visuals, letting users generate 15-second clips that can be spliced into a full music video, using a MiniMax-based model; video credits cost extra (Ashley Carman/Bloomberg)
Artificial Analysis shows GPT-6.2 Astra trailing only Claude Fable 5.2 in its main index, flat vs. GPT-6 Astra in coding; Epoch AI has Astra tied with Fable 5.2 (Matthias Bastian/The Decoder)
Nvidia reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $115.8B, above $109.1B est., Data Center revenue up 110% to $107.6B, and forecasts Q4 revenue above estimates (Nvidia Newsroom)
Cybersecurity startup Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover an RCE flaw in Java dubbed "Java4Shell"; Oracle has released a patch (New York Times)
Sources: the US SEC is investigating Nvidia, including whether the company's disclosures misled investors (Wall Street Journal)
Sources: AppLovin is among companies in talks to acquire ad tech company Criteo, which has a ~$1B market cap after its stock fell 50%+ over the past five years (Milana Vinn/Reuters)
Kalshi says the CFTC has ordered it to halt trading on "mention markets" tied to what President Trump will say during public events (Bobby Allyn/Bloomberg)
Sources: Ramp is in early talks to raise $1B or more led by Coatue and Thrive at a valuation of $70B+, in its third funding round in a year (Kate Clark/Wall Street Journal)
California bans Waymo robotaxis from freeways after a viral video showed one failing to yield to the highway patrol; Waymo halts freeway service nationwide (Jeremy C. Owens/San Francisco ...)
GPT-6.2 Astra review: frustrating to use, the model has no concept of knowledge gaps, its outputs are very hard to parse, and it runs in circles on long tasks (@theo)
Apple's System Status page shows an outage affecting some services; Apple says an "internal update caused some outages" (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
Google updates Gemini Privacy Hub to extend its retention period for temporary chats and chats with history turned off from 72 hours to around two months (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
Xreal Aura review: portable, crisp display, and runs multiple Android apps on a virtual display, but Android XR lacks unique apps and VR controller support (Scott Stein/CNET)
